have you ever felt a burst of emotion
looking out to the sky and ocean
counting the tides and hoping
that this might be an omen

doesn't matter nothing matters when you let go
run away run away go slo mo' (slow motion)
my mind and body stay level
but my heart and soul are rebels

i'm fire and ice
both of 'em

is it me or is everybody crashing
imma rise like a phoenix from the ashes
the old world lies in panic
a new world built by the masses

i'm addicted to the rhythm of the universe
feeling high off the meaning of my inner verse
there's a lie in a truth blessing in a curse
live and die by the pain of the lessons learned

i'm fire and ice
both of 'em

the stars are aligning
the planet is dying
the alpha omega colliding

i move too fast
but when it comes to talking about our feelings
i'm always last

it's not that i don't ever feel those feelings
i feel too much
i'm scared of dealing with my inner demons
so i just run

i got you babe
i got you babe
i got you
i'm still afraid
but i'll be brave
i'm here for you

so sorry that i've been so selfish
i didn't know 
never grew out of being childish
left you alone
and there's no other way for me to say this
except to show
the love we built together is the greatest
i've ever known

i got you babe
i got you babe
i got you
i'm still afraid
but i'll be brave
i'm here for you

and doesn't it mean so much more now
now that we've been through so much

snippet.title: Concussion by Jhameel (official audio)
snippet.description:
This song is about being overwhelmed with stress, so much that you don't even recognize yourself in the mirror.  It's about losing yourself to the darkness, yet still feeling the light fighting to survive inside.

Portrait by Simeon Cochrane

not a thing to my name
only heaven and hell
and a broken home
all the memories
keep haunting me
and i just can't sleep
but i won't let go

cause i'm tired of running
and i'm tired of feeling
like i'm not in control of my own life
so stressed i
can't even see 
i refuse to believe
when i look in the mirror that stranger's me

this is not who i am i must have a concussion
blood rushing
oo

there's a war in the mind
and fear in the eyes
as i look to the path that lies before me
the choir sings
with the violins
and the voice within
tells me to go

in the eye of the storm
in the heat of the moment
i reach for atonement
i can't believe
it's all up to me
can't afford to be weak
when the tension in me just needs release

this is not who i am i must have a concussion
blood rushing
oo

born to be wild
i'm born to be loving you
oo


Love you,
-J
